paragraphs: On Wednesday afternoon, Lily's class played football with Coach Matt. The field was crowded, because two classes played at the same time. Coach Matt had a new white ball with black spots. "Please be careful with it, because it is new," he said. Leo ran very fast, and Mia kicked the ball far. At the end of the game, Leo kicked it too hard. The ball flew over the low fence and disappeared. "Oh no!" said Leo.

Coach Matt was not angry, because the fence was low. "Don't worry," he said. "Here are my instructions." "Leo and Mia, look for the ball behind the fence." "Lily, pick up the bottles on the grass, and put them in the bin by the gate." "I will count the cones," he said. Lily liked her job, because she wanted a clean field. She walked around the grass with a plastic bag.

Behind the fence, Leo and Mia found a small garden with a wooden bench. They walked slowly and looked at every corner of the garden. They looked under the bench, but the ball was not there. "Is it in the flowers?" asked Mia. "It is white, so it is hard to see," said Leo. Mia looked again, and she smiled. "I can see black spots between the leaves!" she said. The ball was under a big green leaf. Leo picked it up and ran back to the field.

Leo gave the ball to Coach Matt. "I am sorry," he said, "because I kicked it too hard." Coach Matt checked the ball, and it was clean and round. "Thank you for telling me," said Coach Matt. "I am glad that you found it." Lily's bag was full, so Leo helped her carry it to the bin. Mia counted the cones with Coach Matt, because she wanted to help, too.

Before they went home, Coach Matt showed Leo a soft kick. "If you kick softly, the ball will stay on the field," he said. Leo tried three times, and the ball stayed in the field every time. "Good!" said Coach Matt. Lily smiled, because the field was clean and the ball was safe.
